planning_notes: The request for 5 MEDIUM difficulty targets was fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct concepts from the available 10. To ensure non-redundancy and high quality, each target targets a unique concept and a unique pedagogical facet. The selection covers the core theoretical foundations (VAE Concept, KL Divergence), the critical implementation mechanism (Reparameterization Trick), the architectural structure (Encoder), and the practical application context (Fashion-MNIST). This provides a balanced assessment of understanding, rationale, code interpretation, and application.
